translationRepairs: He was then transferred to prefect of Ba and Ping.
He was then transferred to prefect of Badong and Jianping.
s0014 巴東、建平二郡太守 names the commanderies Badong and Jianping; “Ba and Ping” truncates both place names, and the proposed idiomatic restores them.
He went out bearer of staff, commander of Liang and Qin military affairs, campaign general who subdues barbarians, and inspector of Nan and Liang.
He went out bearer of staff, commander of Liang and Qin military affairs, campaign general who subdues barbarians, and inspector of Nan Qin and Liang.
s0039 南秦梁二州刺史 is inspector of the two provinces Nan Qin and Liang; the before’s “Nan and Liang” drops 秦 and misstates the jurisdiction, while the proposed idiomatic restores it.

The next year Gaozu received the abdication; Qi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Anchang county in Qi with a fief of five hundred households, and remained Pacification North General and Administrator of Liyang.

s0113 封齊安昌縣侯 enfeoffs the person 齊 as Marquis of Anchang county; “in Qi” is an invented place qualifier from his name, and removing it matches the Chinese.
